verdict.rationale: Requesty is an LLM gateway/router platform, and such a platform could plausibly offer scheduled or background prompt runs, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows user-configurable automations that run autonomously. Automatic fallback, caching and latency routing are request-handling behaviors, not user-defined background jobs. Service accounts only support non-human callers that run elsewhere; Requesty does not execute them.
